title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a colour-blind-safe palette and line styles to the Session 2 app
body:
## Problem
The Session 2 app and figures tell P, PD and PID apart mainly by colour (red, blue, green); some colour-blind users cannot tell them apart.

## Context
Accessibility is part of the quality checklist (QUALITY.md, item 9).

## Expected outcome
A palette plus dashed or dotted line styles that stay distinguishable in light and dark mode and in grayscale.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-02/app.html`, `sessions/session-02/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All three controllers distinguishable in grayscale
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Session 3 app: animate the sideways move with a Play button
body:
## Problem
In the Session 3 app the learner drags a time slider to see the drone lean. A Play button that runs the time from 0 to 8 s would make the cascade much easier to see.

## Context
The app already simulates the whole move; only the drawing needs to step through time.

## Expected outcome
A Play / Pause button that animates the drone view with requestAnimationFrame and keeps the time slider in step.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Works in light and dark mode and on a phone
- [ ] Pause stops the animation; the slider still works
- [ ] No new libraries

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 4: the rate loop and gyroscope noise
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`, Session 4. Real flight controllers run a rate loop inside the attitude loop, and the D term amplifies gyro noise.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 5: integrator wind-up and wind gusts
body:
## Problem
Session 2's integral term has no anti-wind-up, and Session 3's position loop drifts in a steady side wind.

## Context
Roadmap Session 5.

## Expected outcome
A lesson and app where a large climb saturates the thrust, with an anti-wind-up switch and a side-wind slider.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-02/lesson.py`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The roadmap checkpoint is met and shown in a figure
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: a 3-D quadrotor flying a square through a gust
body:
## Problem
The Target is a full 3-D quadrotor with a rate, attitude and position cascade flying a 2 m square at 1.5 m through a gust; there is no public implementation.

## Context
Only the planar first step (Session 3) is published. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation or figure like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Largest distance from the planned square below 10 cm
- [ ] Lands within 5 cm of the start
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
